title: Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for June, 5th (AAPL, COUP, FCSC, GLUU, GM, HQY, LITE, NEWR, PEGA, SFLY)
text:
Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for June, 5th (AAPL, COUP, FCSC, GLUU, GM, HQY, LITE, NEWR, PEGA, SFLY) Tweet
Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Tuesday, June 5th:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its outperform rating reaffirmed by analysts at Royal Bank of Canada. Royal Bank of Canada currently has a $210.00 target price on the stock, up from their previous target price of $203.00. Get Apple alerts:
Coupa Software (NASDAQ:COUP) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald. Cantor Fitzgerald currently has a $67.00 price target on the stock, up from their previous price target of $58.00. The analysts wrote, “: We maintain our Overweight rating on COUP and raise our PT to $67 from $58. We see strength in the company’s cloud-based spend management platform, its extensive network of suppliers, which builds on itself, and recurring revenues generated by its SaaS-based model. Quarterly results were above expectations, and FY19 guidance was raised. Cumulative spend under management was up over 75% y/y. Coupa is growing revenues at a rapid pace and has visibility to profitability over the medium term, in our view. COUP shares are up 1% in after- market trading.”” Fibrocell (NASDAQ:FCSC) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at HC Wainwright. The firm currently has a $22.00 target price on the stock.
Glu Mobile (NASDAQ:GLUU) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Stifel Nicolaus. Stifel Nicolaus currently has a $6.50 price target on the stock, up from their previous price target of $5.50.
General Motors (NYSE:GM) (TSE:GMM.U) had its overweight rating reiterated by analysts at Morgan Stanley. The firm currently has a $50.00 price target on the stock, up from their previous price target of $48.00. They noted that the move was a valuation call. The analysts noted that the move was a valuation call.
Healthequity (NASDAQ:HQY) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at SunTrust Banks. SunTrust Banks currently has a $85.00 price target on the stock, up from their previous price target of $70.00.
Healthequity (NASDAQ:HQY) had its hold rating reiterated by analysts at Robert W. Baird. They currently have a $77.00 price target on the stock, up from their previous price target of $61.00.
Healthequity (NASDAQ:HQY) had its overweight rating reissued by analysts at KeyCorp. KeyCorp currently has a $82.00 target price on the stock, up from their previous target price of $72.00.
Lumentum (NASDAQ:LITE) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Rosenblatt Securities. The firm currently has a $80.00 target price on the stock. The analysts wrote, “We believe the selloff was an overreaction to the news and believe that Lumentum remains the best positioned name in the 3D sensing space. We believe that 3D sensing momentum is likely to occur throughout the balance of this year and should allow Apple (AAPL: Buy) to create new applications and improve performance in its new iPhones and iPad Pros. We view this as a cata- lyst for Lumentum. We reiterate our buy rating and $80 price target. Lumentum’s telecom business should start to see some ramping from ROADM in China in 3Q18. We believe this will help the company’s China business re- gain momentum and return the segment to sequential growth. We believe the company’s CWDM4 shipments to Amazon (AMZN: NR) should ramp sequen- tially in the third quarter, driving new growth in the telecom business. U.S.””
New Relic (NYSE:NEWR) had its outperform rating reiterated by analysts at Wedbush. Wedbush currently has a $116.00 price target on the stock, up from their previous price target of $93.00.
New Relic (NYSE:NEWR) had its outperform rating reaffirmed by analysts at Robert W. Baird. The firm currently has a $115.00 target price on the stock, up from their previous target price of $88.00.
Pegasystems (NASDAQ:PEGA) had its outperform rating reissued by analysts at Wedbush. They currently have a $76.00 target price on the stock.
Shutterfly (NASDAQ:SFLY) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at SunTrust Banks. SunTrust Banks currently has a $111.00 target price on the stock.
Seattle Genetics (NASDAQ:SGEN) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at HC Wainwright. The analysts wrote, “We believe the FDA warning against CPI usage in the first-line setting last month, and the long DOR by CPI treatment in the second-line setting presented at ASCO this weekend, may result in a delay in EV-201 trial enrollment and primary study completion initially planned in 2020. Last month, the FDA issued a warning against single-agent checkpoint inhibition for frontline PDL1-low patients, based on a recent data monitoring committee (DMC) assessment for the phase 3 KEYNOTE-361 study (pembrolizumab, Merck, MRK; not rated) and the phase 3 IMvigor130 study (atezolizumab, Genentech, DNA; not rated) results.””
Smartsheet (NYSE:SMAR) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Canaccord Genuity. Canaccord Genuity currently has a $29.00 target price on the stock, up from their previous target price of $23.00.
